QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Speaking Hall Preparation 5 (Stew)
QuestInfo.0: The Speaking Hall seems to be ready, but Stew looks upset. What's going on?
QuestInfo.1: Stew needs you to borrow some Red Ink from Cole, but there seems to be a quiz involved...
QuestInfo.2: Return to Stew with the ink.

0.0: Why do I always forget the red on the flag?! You'd think I'd remember that every once in a while.
0.1: Look, uh, do you, uh, do you think you could ask that elephant Cole for some of theirs? Please? You're way better at looking dumb than I am.

yes.0: Oh, and tell him the aliens ate his peanut butter cookies. He tries to blame me every time those things get eaten, but I have a peanut allergy! I'd be in the hospital right now if I even touched one.

no.0: Dangit. Maybe I can find some beets.

1.0: Did you tell everyone about the peanut butter cookies?

yes.1: I guess everybody's got allergies. Even Republicans. Maybe I should buy him some cookies to apologize.

stop.0: I know it's just volunteer work, but show some spirit, will ya?
